nodes.name: Every 6h
nodes.notes: ADR-053 Block 2: re-pushes the ClickUp global-rules doc into the four tier agents' static system every 6h. Idempotent — the run SKIPS any agent whose baked rules hash + conventions version already match (no version inflation). The freshness dead-man's-switch is a SEPARATE workflow that catches drift even if this job dies.

nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Test/on-demand entry via scripts/test-subworkflow.mjs. Optional input {force:true} bypasses the skip check and re-versions every agent (used for DoD verification).

nodes.name: Get Anthropic Key
nodes.notes: Reads the anthropic_api_key Vault secret via public.get_anthropic_key() (migration 034). Code nodes can't use n8n credentials and $env/$vars are unavailable here (CLAUDE.md), so a credentialed Postgres read is how the workflow obtains the key.

nodes.name: Get CU Rules
nodes.notes: Reads the global-rules ClickUp doc (Docs v3, text/md) — the SAME endpoint Load Agent Rules uses in assemble-context-and-build-prompt. The global page is q7wz-44812 inside doc q7wz-16892.

nodes.name: Extract Rules
nodes.notes: Flattens the nested pages tree, picks page q7wz-44812 (.content). rules_present guards against syncing an EMPTY rules body over the agents (which would silently wipe their rules).

nodes.name: Rules Present?
nodes.notes: False -> the SSOT doc was unreadable/empty: abort the sync with a CRITICAL rather than baking empty rules into the agents (silent-degradation guard).

nodes.name: Alert Rules Missing
nodes.notes: CRITICAL via Post Alert (v1). Sync aborts here — agents keep their last-good rules rather than being overwritten with nothing.

value.message: Sync agentów przerwany — dokument zasad ogólnych (ClickUp q7wz-44812) nie wczytał się albo jest pusty.
value.details: =Nie nadpisano agentów pustymi zasadami. Sprawdź dostępność doc q7wz-16892 / strony q7wz-44812 oraz poświadczenie ClickUp. page_found={{ $json.page_found }}.

nodes.name: Hash Rules
nodes.notes: SHA256(hex) of the rules markdown. Must be done with the native Crypto node — Code nodes have no crypto on this instance (CLAUDE.md). The freshness dead-man's-switch hashes the SAME content the SAME way and compares against what each live agent carries.

nodes.name: Build System
nodes.notes: Composes the static system = framing + CU global rules (verbatim) + the technical output contract + tools/skills description + a provenance marker carrying rules_sha256 + conventions_version. Also emits the tools[] and skills[] arrays for the agent body. Bump CONV when editing the conventions text to force a re-sync.

nodes.name: Get Agent Rows
nodes.notes: One row per distinct model_id (4 agents): the two Sonnet impact rows collapse to one. agent_id null => create; else the Decide Action node decides update vs skip.

parameters.query: select distinct on (model_id) impact, tier_label, model_id, agent_name, agent_id, agent_version, rules_sha256, conventions_version from agent_routing where active and model_id is not null and model_id <> '' order by model_id, (agent_id is null) desc;

nodes.name: Decide Action
nodes.notes: Per agent: create (no agent_id) / update (rules hash or conventions version changed, or force=true) / skip (already current — avoids version inflation).

nodes.name: Skipped (current)
nodes.notes: Agent already carries the current rules hash + conventions version. No API call (avoids needless new versions).

nodes.name: Upsert Agent
nodes.notes: POST /v1/agents (create) when agent_id is empty, else POST /v1/agents/{id} (new version) — never recreate (Block 0; archive is permanent). Body = name+model+system+tools+skills. Error output routes to a CRITICAL with the HTTP detail; the successful agents still write back. main[1] is the error branch.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ name: $json.agent_name, model: $json.model_id, system: $('Build System').first().json.system, tools: $('Build System').first().json.tools, skills: $('Build System').first().json.skills, mcp_servers: $('Build System').first().json.mcp_servers }, $json.agent_id ? { version: $json.agent_version } : {})) }}

nodes.name: Writeback Routing
nodes.notes: Records agent_id, version, the baked rules hash + conventions version, and synced_at onto EVERY routing row sharing this model_id (so both Sonnet rows stay consistent). Keyed on the response's model.id (object on read) with a string fallback.

parameters.query: update agent_routing set agent_id = $1, agent_version = $2, rules_sha256 = $3, conventions_version = $4, synced_at = now(), updated_at = now() where model_id = $5;

nodes.name: Aggregate Writes
nodes.notes: Collapses the per-agent writeback stream to a single item so Verify Synced runs exactly once.

parameters.jsCode:
const bs = $('Build System').first().json;
return [{ json: { written: $input.all().length, rules_sha256: bs.rules_sha256, conventions_version: bs.conventions_version } }];

nodes.name: Verify Synced
nodes.notes: Post-condition assertion read fresh from the DB (independent of the in-flow items): are ALL active routing rows now on the current rules hash + conventions version with a non-null agent_id? Catches a tier whose upsert failed (its row stays stale).

parameters.query: select bool_and(agent_id is not null and rules_sha256 = $1 and conventions_version = $2) as all_synced, count(*) as total, coalesce(string_agg(distinct tier_label, ', ') filter (where agent_id is null or rules_sha256 is distinct from $1 or conventions_version is distinct from $2), '') as stale_tiers from agent_routing where active and model_id is not null and model_id <> '';

nodes.name: Sync OK
nodes.notes: Terminal for the healthy path. Silent on purpose — a successful sync must not post to the Alerts task every 6h.

nodes.name: Alert Sync Incomplete
nodes.notes: CRITICAL via Post Alert (v1): at least one tier is NOT on the current rules. The next scheduled run self-heals the stale tiers (idempotent); this surfaces it loudly meanwhile.

value.message: Sync agentów niekompletny — nie wszystkie tiery są na najnowszych zasadach.
value.details: =Tiery niezsynchronizowane: {{ $json.stale_tiers }}. Sprawdź ostatnie wykonanie Sync Agent Definitions (v1) i alerty managed-agents/sync. Do czasu naprawy te tiery niosą starsze zasady.

nodes.name: Alert Upsert Failed
nodes.notes: CRITICAL via Post Alert (v1) with the HTTP error + which tier failed. Routed from Upsert Agent's error output so one tier failing doesn't abort the others.
